messages.subject: error message of using fitqtl
parts:
Hi there,

I am trying to run fitqtl, but I got an error. Suppose I have a set of
data, and the code what I was using is as follow:

>data.sim = sim.geno(data, step=2, n.draws=16, error.prob=0.01)
>chr = c(2, 2, 11)
>pos = c(10, 70, 20)
>qtl = makeqtl(data.sim, chr, pos)
>my.formula = y ~ Q1 + Q2 + Q3 + Q1:Q2
>out.fitqtl = fitqtl(data.sim, qtl=qtl, formula=my.formula)


But I got an error message like:

Error in as.double.default(pheno) : (list) object cannot be coerced to
'double'

Does any one can help figuring out what the problem is?

Thanks!



PR

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] error message of using fitqtl
parts:
It's not easy to tell what's going on. It's possible that the first
phenotype
is your data is not numeric, but I would think that we would catch
that sort of
error.

If you could send my your data file, I'll be able to figure out for
sure what's
going on, and make sure that a more appropriate error message is
given, at the
very least.

karl
